description: Local stdio MCP server that renders charts via a self-hosted QuickChart instance (Chart.js 4 configs, incl. boxplot/violin, error bars, funnel, geo, graph, pcp, venn and word cloud chart types) and saves the resulting PNG/SVG/PDF to an agent-specified directory.
name: io.github.magicxor/QuickChartMcp

environmentVariables.name: QuickChart__BaseUrl
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the QuickChart instance (e.g. http://localhost:3400).

environmentVariables.name: QuickChart__TimeoutSeconds
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for QuickChart requests (default 60).

environmentVariables.name: QuickChart__AllowedOutputPatterns__0
environmentVariables.description: First regex in the output-directory allow-list (case-insensitive). Add __1, __2, ... for more. An empty allow-list denies ALL writes, so at least one pattern is required for the tool to save files. Example: ^C:\\Users\\me\\charts(\\|$)
